label: Holy Goat fresh curd, La Luna and Nectar

about.text: Goat cheeses from an organic farm at Sutton Grange in Victoria: a fresh curd, La Luna (a ring-shaped cheese with a geotrichum rind) and Nectar (a semi-soft, washed-rind cheese). The milk is batch-pasteurised, and the curds are ladled by hand into hoops.

sources.text: What the cheeses are and how they are made, from this article.
